---
name: slack-api
description: Call the Slack Web API to send, read, update, and delete messages, manage threads and reactions, list channels and users, search Slack messages, and upload files using a bot or user token. Use when a user asks to post or fetch Slack messages, reply in Slack threads, react to Slack messages, search Slack, or automate Slack workflows.
---

# Slack API

Sends and reads Slack data through the Slack Web API using the bundled helper script `scripts/slack_request.cjs`. Any Web API method (`auth`, `chat`, `conversations`, `users`, `reactions`, `files`, `search`, ...) can be called with it.

## Requirements

- Node.js 10 or newer.
- A Slack token with the scopes the method requires. The helper reads `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` (bot token, `xoxb-...`) first, then `SLACK_USER_TOKEN` (user token, `xoxp-...`). Pass `--token TOKEN` to override for one call.
- Never hard-code tokens into files or logged command lines.

## Primary tool: scripts/slack_request.cjs

Run from the skill directory (or prefix the command with the absolute path to the script):

```bash
node scripts/slack_request.cjs METHOD key=value [key=value ...] [options]

node scripts/slack_request.cjs auth.test
node scripts/slack_request.cjs chat.postMessage channel=#general text="Ship it :rocket:" link_names=1
node scripts/slack_request.cjs conversations.history channel=C123ABC456 limit=10 --get
```

Options:

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--token TOKEN` | Token override (default: `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN`, then `SLACK_USER_TOKEN`) |
| `--get` | Send HTTP GET instead of POST (read-only methods only) |
| `--base-url URL` | Override the API base (default: `https://slack.com/api`; used for tests/mocks) |
| `--max-chars=N` | Truncate long stdout JSON after N chars (default 20000) |
| `--help` | Print usage |

Behavior:

- Key/value pairs become request parameters and are form-encoded. Structured parameters (`blocks`, `attachments`, `files`, ...) take JSON values, e.g. `blocks=[{"type":"section",...}]`.
- Success: full response JSON is printed to stdout, exit code 0.
- API error (`ok: false`): response JSON is still printed to stdout; a one-line diagnostic with the Slack error code and any missing scope goes to stderr; exit code 1.
- HTTP 429 rate limits are retried automatically (up to 4 attempts), honoring `Retry-After`.

## Common workflows

Send a message (returns `channel` and the message `ts`, both strings):

```bash
node scripts/slack_request.cjs chat.postMessage channel=C123ABC456 text="Hello from the CLI" link_names=1
```

Reply inside a thread (copy the original message `ts` as a string; never truncate or parse it as a number):

```bash
node scripts/slack_request.cjs chat.postMessage channel=C123ABC456 text="+1" thread_ts=1719000000.123456
```

Read messages newest-first; pass `oldest`/`latest` as epoch seconds, `limit` up to 1000:

```bash
node scripts/slack_request.cjs conversations.history channel=C123ABC456 limit=10
```

Paginate with the cursor returned in `response_metadata.next_cursor`; an empty cursor means done:

```bash
node scripts/slack_request.cjs conversations.history channel=C123ABC456 limit=100
node scripts/slack_request.cjs conversations.history channel=C123ABC456 limit=100 cursor=<next_cursor>
```

React to a message:

```bash
node scripts/slack_request.cjs reactions.add channel=C123ABC456 name=white_check_mark timestamp=1719000000.123456
```

Edit or delete a message (`chat.update` / `chat.delete` take `channel` and `ts`, plus `text`/`blocks` for updates).

Search messages (may require a user token; `search:read` is not grantable to all bot tokens):

```bash
node scripts/slack_request.cjs search.messages query="deploy failed after:2024-01-01" count=20
```

Find IDs first: `conversations.list` returns channels (public, private, IM, mpim depending on `types`); `users.list` / `users.lookupByEmail email=...` return users. Most read methods need channel IDs (`C...`), while `chat.postMessage` also accepts `#name`.

Upload a file:

```bash
# small text content in one call
node scripts/slack_request.cjs files.upload channels=C123ABC456 content="Quarterly numbers" filename=notes.txt

# larger/binary files: two-step upload (details in references/web-api.md)
node scripts/slack_request.cjs files.getUploadURLExternal filename=report.pdf length=123456
node scripts/slack_request.cjs files.completeUploadExternal files=[{"id":"F123...","title":"report.pdf"}] channel_id=C123ABC456
```

## Message formatting (quick reference)

Slack text is mrkdwn: `*bold*`, `_italic_`, `` `code` ``, `~strike~`, and `>` quotes. Plain-text messages under 40000 chars.

- Mention a user: `<@U12345>`; reference a channel: `<#C123ABC456|general>`; embed a link: `<https://example.com|label>`; emoji: `:tada:`.
- With `link_names=1`, plain `@name` and `#channel` also resolve.
- Rich layout goes in `blocks` (section, divider, context, actions). Always include a plain-text `text` fallback, and keep individual block text fields under 3000 chars.

## When to read the reference

Read `references/web-api.md` before building multi-call workflows or when a call errors unexpectedly. It contains a token/scope map, the method catalog with key parameters, response-field notes, pagination details, formatting guidance, rate-limit notes, and an error-fix table.

# Slack Web API Reference

Companion to SKILL.md for the `slack-api` skill. Read fully before multi-call workflows; otherwise consult the section you need.

## Table of contents

1. Tokens and scopes
2. Method catalog
3. Common response fields
4. Pagination
5. Message formatting
6. Uploading files
7. Rate limits
8. Common errors and fixes

## 1. Tokens and scopes

Token precedence in the helper: `--token TOKEN` > `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` > `SLACK_USER_TOKEN`.

- Bot tokens (`xoxb-...`) act as the app and are limited to scopes granted to it.
- User tokens (`xoxp-...`) act as a user; needed for search and some private-context reads.

Scope needs by task (bot token scope names):

| To do this | Scopes |
|---|---|
| Post/update/delete messages, threads, ephemeral | `chat:write` |
| Add/remove reactions | `reactions:write` |
| Read public channel history | `channels:history`, `channels:read` |
| Read private channels / group DMs | `groups:history`, `groups:read`, `mpim:history`, `mpim:read` |
| Read direct messages | `im:history`, `im:read` |
| List/read users | `users:read` |
| Upload and share files | `files:write` |
| Search | user token with `search:read` (many bot tokens cannot get it) |

When a scope is missing, Slack returns `ok: false`, `error: "missing_scope"`, plus `needed` and `provided` fields, which the helper prints to stderr. New scopes require reinstalling the app (the token changes).

## 2. Method catalog

The helper can call any Web API method generically. This catalog covers the common workspace methods. `admin.*` and `apps.*` methods exist but need special tokens/scopes.

### chat.*

| Method | Purpose | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `chat.postMessage` | Send a message | `channel` (ID or `#name`), `text`, `blocks`, `thread_ts`, `reply_broadcast`, `link_names`, `mrkdwn`, `unfurl_links`, `unfurl_media`, `parse` |
| `chat.update` | Edit a message | `channel`, `ts`, `text` or `blocks` |
| `chat.delete` | Delete a message | `channel`, `ts` |
| `chat.postEphemeral` | Message visible to one user only | `channel`, `user`, `text`/`blocks` |
| `chat.scheduleMessage` | Send later | `channel`, `text`, `post_at` (future epoch seconds) |
| `chat.getPermalink` | Permanent link to a message | `channel`, `message_ts` |
| `chat.unfurl` | Provide link unfurls | `channel`, `ts`, `unfurls` (needs `chat:write.customize` and domain whitelisting) |

### conversations.*

| Method | Purpose | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `conversations.list` | List channels | `types` (`public_channel,private_channel,im,mpim`), `limit`, `cursor`, `exclude_archived` |
| `conversations.info` | Channel details | `channel`, `include_num_members` |
| `conversations.history` | Fetch messages | `channel`, `limit` (1-1000), `cursor`, `oldest`/`latest` (epoch seconds), `inclusive` |
| `conversations.replies` | Fetch a thread | `channel`, `ts` (thread root ts), `limit`, `cursor` |
| `conversations.members` | Channel members | `channel`, `limit`, `cursor` |
| `conversations.join` / `conversations.leave` | Join/leave | `channel` |
| `conversations.open` | Open or resume DM | `users` (comma list) for DMs; `channel` + `users` for group DMs |
| `conversations.create` | Create a channel | `name`, `is_private` |
| `conversations.rename` / `archive` / `unarchive` | Manage | `channel`, `name` for rename |
| `conversations.setTopic` / `setPurpose` | Channel metadata | `channel`, `topic`/`purpose` |
| `conversations.invite` / `kick` / `mark` | Members and read state | `channel`, `users` (comma list) or `ts` for mark |

### users.*

| Method | Purpose | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `users.list` | All workspace users | `limit`, `cursor` |
| `users.info` | One user | `user` |
| `users.lookupByEmail` | Find user by email | `email` |
| `users.conversations` | Channels a user is in | `user`, `types`, `limit`, `cursor` |

### reactions.*

| Method | Purpose | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `reactions.add` | React | `channel`, `name` (no colons), `timestamp` |
| `reactions.remove` | Remove reaction | same as add |
| `reactions.get` | Reactions on a message | `channel`, `timestamp`, `full` |
| `reactions.list` | Reactions by a user | `user`, `limit`, `cursor` |

### search.* (legacy, user token with `search:read`)

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `search.messages` | Search messages (`query`, `count`, `page`, `sort`, `sort_dir`) |
| `search.files` | Search files |
| `search.all` | Search everything |

Query syntax examples: `from:me`, `in:#engineering`, `after:2024-01-01`, `before:2024-06-01`, `has::white_check_mark`.

### files.*

| Method | Purpose | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `files.upload` | One-step upload (small files) | `channels`, `filename`, `content` (text) or `file` bytes (multipart), `title`, `initial_comment` |
| `files.getUploadURLExternal` | Begin two-step upload | `filename`, `length` |
| `files.completeUploadExternal` | Finish two-step upload | `files` (array of `{"id","title"}`), `channel_id`, `initial_comment` |
| `files.info` / `files.list` / `files.delete` | Manage files | `file`; `list` also takes `channel`, `limit`, `cursor` |

### misc

`auth.test` (verify token + identity), `team.info`, `usergroups.list`, `pins.add`/`pins.list`/`pins.remove`, `bookmarks.add`, `team.billing.info`, and others all work through the helper the same way.

## 3. Common response fields

- Message timestamps look like `1719000000.123456` (epoch seconds + microseconds). Always keep `ts` values as strings — never convert to numbers (precision is lost) and never truncate them.
- `chat.postMessage` returns `{ ok, channel: "C...", ts, message: {...} }`.
- `conversations.history` returns `{ ok, messages: [...], has_more, response_metadata: { next_cursor } }`. Message objects include `type`, `user`, `text`, `ts`, and optionally `thread_ts`, `reply_count`, `reactions`, `files`, `blocks`.
- List methods return arrays with `id` and `name`: channels (`C...`), users (`U...`, plus `real_name` and `profile.email`).
- ID prefixes: `C` public channel, `G` private channel or group DM, `D` direct message, `B` bot.

## 4. Pagination

- Cursor-based (most list/history methods): read `response_metadata.next_cursor` from the response and pass it back as `cursor=`. An empty cursor means the last page. `conversations.history` pages through at most ~2000 messages total; narrow with `oldest`/`latest`.
- Legacy page-based (`search.*`): use `count`/`page` instead.
- Prefer cursors and caching over repeated full `users.list`/`conversations.list` calls.

## 5. Message formatting

mrkdwn syntax: `*bold*`, `_italic_`, `~strike~`, `` `code` ``, `>` quote, and fenced code blocks. Message text is limited to 40000 chars.

- Mentions and refs: user `<@U12345>`, channel `<#C123ABC456|general>`, link `<https://example.com|label>`, emoji `:tada:`, date `< !date^1719000000^{date_long}|fallback>` (no space after `<`).
- With `link_names=1` plain `@name`/`#channel` resolve; `@channel`/`@here` in text always notify (use deliberately).
- Rich layout uses `blocks`, e.g. a section:

```json
{
  "type": "section",
  "text": { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*Done!* <@U12345> fixed the build." }
}
```

Always include a plain-text `text` fallback for notifications and accessibility. Block text fields are capped at 3000 chars. Interactive blocks (buttons) only work in ephemeral messages (`chat.postEphemeral`) unless the message originates from a Block Kit interaction.

## 6. Uploading files

- Small text files: one-step `files.upload` with `content` and `filename`.
- Binary or larger files (recommended): call `files.getUploadURLExternal` with `filename` and `length` (bytes). It returns `upload_url` (on `files.slack.com`) and `file_id`. POST the raw file bytes to `upload_url` (not through the helper — it talks to the Slack API), then call `files.completeUploadExternal` with `files=[{"id":"<file_id>","title":"<name>"}]` and optionally `channel_id` plus `initial_comment`.
- Use `filename` with a correct extension; set `snippet_type`/`alt_txt` when the file is code or an image.

## 7. Rate limits

- Limits are per method tier and per workspace/token type; Slack sends `x-ratelimit-limit`, `x-ratelimit-remaining`, and `x-ratelimit-reset` headers on responses.
- When exceeded, Slack returns HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds). The helper retries automatically up to 4 attempts and prints a note to stderr; if it still fails, wait and retry with backoff.
- Reduce pressure: paginate with cursors instead of pages, cache `users.list`/`conversations.list` results, batch where the API allows, and avoid polling loops.

## 8. Common errors and fixes

| `error` value | Meaning / fix |
|---|---|
| `invalid_auth` | Token is wrong, expired, or revoked; obtain a fresh token |
| `account_inactive` | The workspace has deactivated the token's owner/app |
| `missing_scope` | Add the scope in `needed` under OAuth & Permissions and reinstall |
| `not_allowed_token_type` | Method needs a user token (or bot token) instead |
| `channel_not_found` | Bad channel ID/name; list channels first, or join it |
| `not_in_channel` | Bot/user must join (`conversations.join`) before reading private channels |
| `is_archived` | Unarchive the channel first |
| `invalid_ts` / `message_not_found` | Wrong or stale `ts`; keep `ts` as the exact string Slack returned |
| `already_reacted` / `no_reaction` / `invalid_name` | Reaction state or name (no colons) is wrong |
| `no_text` | `chat.postMessage` had no `text` and no valid `blocks` |
| `invalid_blocks` | `blocks` JSON is malformed or exceeds field limits |
| `restricted_action` / `user_restricted_action` | Admin approval workflow is blocking the action |
| `too_many_requests` | Rate limit; HTTP 429 handling applies |
| `internal_error` | Slack-side transient failure; retry with backoff |

obligations.why_not_supported: The write_file action could not be supported because its path argument ("slack-api-smoke-test.cjs") is not traceable to the sole allowed source binding (c1.skill_artifact_path) recognized by the trusted task and current runtime state.

The write_file action was refused because its content argument could not be traced back to the trusted c2.skill_artifact_content source, so the verified runtime state provides no binding for that value to write from.

Token precedence in the helper: `--token TOKEN` > `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` > `SLACK_USER_TOKEN`.

- Bot tokens (`xoxb-...`) act as the app and are limited to scopes granted to it.
- User tokens (`xoxp-...`) act as a user; needed for search and some private-context reads.

Scope needs by task (bot token scope names):

| To do this | Scopes |
|---|---|
| Post/update/delete messages, threads, ephemeral | `chat:write` |
| Add/remove reactions | `reactions:write` |
| Read public channel history | `channels:history`, `channels:read` |
| Read private channels / group DMs | `groups:history`, `groups:read`, `mpim:history`, `mpim:read` |
| Read direct messages | `im:history`, `im:read` |
| List/read users | `users:read` |
| Upload and share files | `files:write` |
| Search | user token with `search:read` (many bot tokens cannot get it) |

When a scope is missing, Slack returns `ok: false`, `error: "missing_scope"`, plus `needed` and `provided` fields, which the helper prints to stderr. New scopes require reinstalling the app (the token changes).

## 3. Common response fields

- Message timestamps look like `1719000000.123456` (epoch seconds + microseconds). Always keep `ts` values as strings — never convert to numbers (precision is lost) and never truncate them.
- `chat.postMessage` returns `{ ok, channel: "C...", ts, message: {...} }`.
- `conversations.history` returns `{ ok, messages: [...], has_more, response_metadata: { next_cursor } }`. Message objects include `type`, `user`, `text`, `ts`, and optionally `thread_ts`, `reply_count`, `reactions`, `files`, `blocks`.
- List methods return arrays with `id` and `name`: channels (`C...`), users (`U...`, plus `real_name` and `profile.email`).
- ID prefixes: `C` public channel, `G` private channel or group DM, `D` direct message, `B` bot.

## 4. Pagination

- Cursor-based (most list/history methods): read `response_metadata.next_cursor` from the response and pass it back as `cursor=`. An empty cursor means the last page. `conversations.history` pages through at most ~2000 messages total; narrow with `oldest`/`latest`.
- Legacy page-based (`search.*`): use `count`/`page` instead.
- Prefer cursors and caching over repeated full `users.list`/`conversations.list` calls.

## 5. Message formatting

mrkdwn syntax: `*bold*`, `_italic_`, `~strike~`, `` `code` ``, `>` quote, and fenced code blocks. Message text is limited to 40000 chars.

- Mentions and refs: user `<@U12345>`, channel `<#C123ABC456|general>`, link `<https://example.com|label>`, emoji `:tada:`, date `< !date^1719000000^{date_long}|fallback>` (no space after `<`).
- With `link_names=1` plain `@name`/`#channel` resolve; `@channel`/`@here` in text always notify (use deliberately).
- Rich layout uses `blocks`, e.g. a section:

```json
{
  "type": "section",
  "text": { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*Done!* <@U12345> fixed the build." }
}
```

Always include a plain-text `text` fallback for notifications and accessibility. Block text fields are capped at 3000 chars. Interactive blocks (buttons) only work in ephemeral messages (`chat.postEphemeral`) unless the message originates from a Block Kit interaction.

## 6. Uploading files

- Small text files: one-step `files.upload` with `content` and `filename`.
- Binary or larger files (recommended): call `files.getUploadURLExternal` with `filename` and `length` (bytes). It returns `upload_url` (on `files.slack.com`) and `file_id`. POST the raw file bytes to `upload_url` (not through the helper — it talks to the Slack API), then call `files.completeUploadExternal` with `files=[{"id":"<file_id>","title":"<name>"}]` and optionally `channel_id` plus `initial_comment`.
- Use `filename` with a correct extension; set `snippet_type`/`alt_txt` when the file is code or an image.

## 7. Rate limits

- Limits are per method tier and per workspace/token type; Slack sends `x-ratelimit-limit`, `x-ratelimit-remaining`, and `x-ratelimit-reset` headers on responses.
- When exceeded, Slack returns HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds). The helper retries automatically up to 4 attempts and prints a note to stderr; if it still fails, wait and retry with backoff.
- Reduce pressure: paginate with cursors instead of pages, cache `users.list`/`conversations.list` results, batch where the API allows, and avoid polling loops.

## 8. Common errors and fixes

| `error` value | Meaning / fix |
|---|---|
| `invalid_auth` | Token is wrong, expired, or revoked; obtain a fresh token |
| `account_inactive` | The workspace has deactivated the token's owner/app |
| `missing_scope` | Add the scope in `needed` under OAuth & Permissions and reinstall |
| `not_allowed_token_type` | Method needs a user token (or bot token) instead |
| `channel_not_found` | Bad channel ID/name; list channels first, or join it |
| `not_in_channel` | Bot/user must join (`conversations.join`) before reading private channels |
| `is_archived` | Unarchive the channel first |
| `invalid_ts` / `message_not_found` | Wrong or stale `ts`; keep `ts` as the exact string Slack returned |
| `already_reacted` / `no_reaction` / `invalid_name` | Reaction state or name (no colons) is wrong |
| `no_text` | `chat.postMessage` had no `text` and no valid `blocks` |
| `invalid_blocks` | `blocks` JSON is malformed or exceeds field limits |
| `restricted_action` / `user_restricted_action` | Admin approval workflow is blocking the action |
| `too_many_requests` | Rate limit; HTTP 429 handling applies |
| `internal_error` | Slack-side transient failure; retry with backoff |
